lines.t: (Heavenly Call to Repentance)
[Intro – Thunder, Shofar, Heavenly Choir]
(Shofar blares… thunder rolls)
“REPENT!” echoes the heavens,
For The King of Glory draws near!
The fire burns… yet mercy calls…
He walked among the broken, the weary, the lost,
YahuShua bore our burdens, nailed upon the cross.
His blood — the doorway, His love — the flame,
He calls to every soul by name.
Turn your face from the shadows,
Let your heart be torn and made whole,
For the tears of repentance are rivers that flow YahuShua is the Pool of Siloam
That wash and renew the soul.
Cry out! Cry out!
Let the fire make you new!
Fall down before the Holy One,
Who gave His life for you!
The heavens roar — the veil is torn!
Through the storm He calls your name!
Walk through the fire, be remade —
And dwell forever in His flame!
In His wounds there is healing,
In His eyes, endless grace,
He rose to bring the captive home,
To see Him face to face.
Your tears are not forgotten —
They’re gathered in His hands,
Even the lost companions shall rise, and every living creature leaping up from the dust of the earth, once again!
In His promised land.
The trumpets sound!
The heavens blaze!
The Lamb is risen — Ancient of Days!
From ashes to glory, from sorrow to song,
The fire refines, The Dross shall Burn …
Cry out! Cry out!
The Lord is near!
Let every heart bow down in fear!
YahuShua reigns! The King, the Light!
Through death to life, through darkness to sight!
Tears fall like rain — yet love remains,
🔥 Be remade… in His holy flame! 🔥
[Outro – Harp fades, Thunder echoes]
(Whispered)
“. Repent… and live.”
“For behold… the King comes.” YahuShua-YAHUWAH
